items.q: Coon- (Inaudible) Sanders, or whoever would come in there, you know

ctx.x: (Inaudible) Small's Paradise, or one of the clubs in Atlantic City -- big clubs like that -- you saw a show!

An hour and a half -- an hour a show. I mean, every act that went out on the floor just knocked you over. When you leave there, you'd say, "Oh man, we gotta go back to Small's Paradise." You know, got to go to the Silver Slipper.

You go to -- Steel Craig got two big bands. Fletcher Henderson, another big white band -- to any of them, you know. Coon- (Inaudible) Sanders, or whoever would come in there, you know -- and all these other things happening there.
